meta.name: public-speaking
meta.description: Public speaking and oral presentation skills for effective communication. Covers speech structure (introduction, body, conclusion), delivery techniques (projection, pace, pause, gesture), audience analysis, impromptu and extemporaneous methods, managing anxiety, visual aids, and persuasive versus informative speaking. Use when preparing speeches, practicing delivery, analyzing presentations, or building confidence in oral communication.
